businesses.business: diagnostic imaging agents and radiopharmaceutical manufacturing

offering_description.value: Lantheus sells PET imaging agents and ultrasound contrast agents to hospitals, imaging centers and radiopharmacies. It supplies imaging agents through manufacturing and distribution partners and provides contract radiopharmaceutical development and manufacturing for drug developers.

primary_products.value: PSMA-targeted PET tracers; beta-amyloid PET tracers; ultrasound microbubble contrast agents

primary_services.value: radiopharmaceutical development; clinical and commercial radiopharmaceutical contract manufacturing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospitals, diagnostic imaging centers, nuclear pharmacies and pharmaceutical developers

end_markets.value: oncology imaging; cardiovascular imaging; neurodegenerative disease imaging; radiopharmaceutical drug development

revenue_model.value: product sales: PET imaging tracers and ultrasound contrast agents; project or contract: Radiopharmaceutical development and manufacturing for drug developers; licensing or royalties: Commercial rights to imaging agents marketed by partners
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Develops imaging agents and manufactures them internally or through partners for radiopharmacies and healthcare providers; service provider: Develops and manufactures clinical and commercial radiopharmaceuticals for drug developers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with selected imaging agents marketed in Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: PET radiopharmaceuticals, ultrasound contrast agents and radiopharmaceutical development and manufacturing

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Nuclear pharmacy networks supply PET tracers to imaging sites; direct sales: Commercial teams serve hospitals, imaging centers and drug developers; partners / resellers: Commercial partners market selected imaging agents internationally
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Imaging drugs require FDA or equivalent approvals, and radioactive materials handling requires nuclear regulatory licenses

notes: International availability varies by product, and the full list of countries served is uncertain.
